about: Ontario Tech north Oshawa campus. Lot outlines are OpenStreetMap polygons (property 'osm'; data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL) matched to lot names on the university's North Campus Parking Map. Founders 6 and Commencement South are not in OpenStreetMap and are sketched from the campus map. access: daily = bookable in OpenBay; permit / employees = shown on the map for context only. Landmark positions are from OpenStreetMap via Nominatim. Aisles (OSM service=parking_aisle and service roads), grass islands and building footprints come from OpenStreetMap via OpenFreeMap vector tiles (zoom 14); spots are laid out along the aisles.
